notes.title: Developer's Live Stream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37543176/1dfdbccf337b047d70f5745be06583100e96fef4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Developer's Live Stream[/h1]
Hello!
We are very excited about streaming our game and we want you to join us as we play through our demo. Soulz is a [b]strategic duel CCG[/b] with board-based deep tactical play with various cards and decks. [b]You can beat Devs[/b] if we can meet on a match. Let’s play SOULZ!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37543176/c9f4b2dfa6523aa49212ec6084bb3f72fdef2c9c.jpg[/img]
